title: Enantiomers rotate light oppositely
caption: (R)- and (S)-butan-2-ol rotate plane-polarised light by the same angle in opposite directions. A 50:50 racemic mixture shows no rotation, because the two effects cancel.
alt: The two enantiomers of butan-2-ol, labelled with opposite signs of optical rotation.
description: (R)-(−)-butan-2-ol rotates it anticlockwise by the same angle.
